sok.text: Kyodai is born in Saviors of Kamigawa when Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One at Jukai Forest, who takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko. The Taken One had summoned O-Kagachi, who manifests all eight heads.

Kyodai and Michiko merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads, and Konda is turned to stone and shattered. Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil, and the war ends.

Kyodai summons Hidetsugu, the new chaos oni, who devours the failed oni, becomes the most formidable demonic entity, and is imprisoned in the spirit realm by Kyodai. Michiko, with Kyodai's support, uncovers the real cause of the Kami War, facing opposition.

dbl.text: In Innistrad: Double Feature, Kaito finds Kyodai writhing in distress in the water and the emperor missing, and sees a man with a metal arm rise from the fog beside her. Later he and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.

Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand, stabilizing her for a time, and using her bond with Kyodai, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound. Tezzeret then takes control of the Reality Chip, destabilizing the Wanderer's spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.

Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo, and the Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple. With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
